name: Klooboo
summary:
Klooboo is a feed of short casual games that you swipe through. The catalog includes a 3D runner (Boo Runner), a hold-to-grow plank game (Plank Hop), a pour-and-sort puzzle (Potion Sort), a basketball tap game (Hoops), a 3D BMX park (Big Air BMX), an aim-and-shoot game (Cannon Blast), a tap-a-line traffic puzzle (Traffic Jam), an eat-and-grow arcade game (Chomp), a merge puzzle (Merge Drop), a block puzzle (Block Party), a tile-matching game (Tile Trio), a hidden-sticker game (Sticker Hunt), a jigsaw (Jigsaw Snap) and a lantern-carving game (Lantern Carve).

In most games, players can make their own world by describing it in a few words. The art is AI-made, in the built-in worlds and in the ones players make; the rules are written as code. Worlds can be shared as a link or a short video and played by anyone. Klooboo plays on iPhone, Android and in a web browser, with no account needed to play. Making uses credits; a new account starts with 160 free. Free to play, no ads. For players 13 and up.
